title: Cosmic Veins in Stone
description: A dark, cavernous opening reveals a black void filled with glowing golden vein-like structures and scattered white specks resembling stars. The surrounding rock appears textured with rough, multicolored mineral formations in shades of red, orange, brown, and grey under dramatic lighting.
prompt: A surreal dark cavern interior with a deep black void at its center, intricate glowing golden organic vein patterns floating within the darkness like cosmic roots, surrounded by rough textured mineral rock formations in deep reds, oranges and greys, dramatic atmospheric lighting with floating white particles resembling stars, mysterious and ethereal atmosphere, dark fantasy art
